assay_run.method: Study-level comparison aggregate; this row represents the selected preparation groups rather than an individually identified acquisition. PXD062669 LC-MS/MS proteomics comparison of negative-control siRNA and Vdr siRNA C2C12 materials; LC-MS/MS-based bottom-up proteomics. Proteins were precipitated with acetone, reduced, alkylated, desalted, digested with Trypsin/Lys-C, and 1.5 µg peptides were analyzed using an Orbitrap Q Exactive HF with a Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano System; RAW spectra were processed with Proteome Discoverer. The assay group is the reported negative-control siRNA versus Vdr siRNA proteomics comparison; sample-to-file mapping is unresolved. Multiple sample IDs preserve group associations and do not establish physical pooling.
assay_run.platform: Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Q Exactive HF; Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano
